items.stem: Which research method best describes the study by Kosfeld et al. (2005) on oxytocin and trust?
options: meta-analysis
laboratory experiment
ethnographic participant observation
covert participant observation
items.answer: laboratory experiment
items.markingKey: B. Kosfeld et al. (2005): 58 healthy male students received intranasal oxytocin or a placebo (double-blind) and played an investment game as investors deciding how much money to transfer to a trustee.

items.stem: Outline the findings of Kosfeld et al. (2005) and explain one conclusion about the role of oxytocin in trust that can be drawn from them.
items.answer: Findings: 45% of the oxytocin group transferred the maximum amount vs 21% of the placebo group; oxytocin did not affect risk-taking when playing against a computer. Link: these results are evidence about the role of oxytocin in trust.

items.stem: Using an evolutionary explanation, suggest why people may find spiders more frightening than cars, even though cars kill far more people.
